info.name: Core: Background Ability Scores
info.description: Ability score increases for 2024 backgrounds: the +2/+1 or +1/+1/+1 choice over three abilities.
info.author: DaybreakBuilder contributors

description.p: Ability score increases come from the background (2024 rules), so species don't grant their own.

Under the 2024 rules, a background without its own ability scores lets you increase one ability score by 2 and another by 1, or three scores by 1. This replaces your species' ability score increases.
Under the 2024 rules, a background that doesn't give a feat lets you choose an Origin feat.
